_what_this_is: An INDEX of the capture registry, not the registry. One row per observation, carrying the address, date, evidence class, card counts, PER where computed, failure modes, and the one-line finding. The full record — verbatim transcripts, citation transcriptions, interface observations, the seating ledger — is 21 MB and lives at rebuild/capture-registry/EA-WG-CAPTURES-01-REBUILD.json.

_read_this_first.NULL IS NOT ZERO: cards: null means an apparatus was not opened or not captured. It never means the surface returned nothing. 125 observations are flagged truncated: a "Show more" control was in frame, so absence in them is absence from the visible portion.
_read_this_first.TWO EVIDENCE CLASSES: evidence: "paste" is a capture-time verbatim record with a read strip. "ocr" is a screenshot stream with browser chrome interleaved, seated but NOT read line by line. CARD COUNTS ARE NOT COMPARABLE ACROSS THE TWO.
_read_this_first.PER IS FOUR-UNIT AND PARTIAL ELSEWHERE: per is computed only where a strip was read. It is null on every OCR record by design; a three-unit PER over answer text alone is possible but has not been computed and would not be comparable.
_read_this_first.FINDINGS ARE PERISHABLE: every row records a state at a date. Nothing marks a finding still-true and no pass revisits. Four series cross the 19 June termination and they do not move together.
